title: Phase 2 Resumable Job And Progress Protocol
description:
Phase 2 of the Interactive Job Runtime Refactor (master ticket 26/08/20/INTERACTIVE-JOB-RUNTIME-REFACTOR).

Introduce the universal resumable job protocol that every later phase builds on.

Governing rule: no interactive operation is a function call that runs until the operation is finished; every interactive operation is a persistent state machine whose individual step is bounded, cancellable, observable and preview-producing.

Deliverables:
- InteractiveJob trait with a synchronous, explicitly resumable step(&mut StepContext) -> StepOutcome, where StepOutcome is Yield, PreviewReady, CheckpointReady, Complete(CommitCandidate), Cancelled or Fault. StepContext carries deadline, fuel, cancellation, operation id, generation and a preview sink. Typical step 0.5-2 ms, 8 ms hard ceiling. Structured child jobs owned by the parent scope.
- Progress as data: a standard stream vocabulary (Started, StageChanged, CandidateTested, PreviewPatch, Diagnostic, Checkpoint, CommitCandidate, Completed, Cancelled, Failed) with explicit channel policies - pointer and hover latest-wins, preview geometry coalesced by operation/entity/stage, commits and checkpoints lossless bounded, diagnostics a bounded ring, telemetry lossy, large geometry byte-credit controlled. The UI never receives a direct callback from a simulation.
- Three state classes kept distinct: authoritative document snapshot (immutable, revisioned, undoable, model-actor only), operation state (worker-owned, transient), preview overlay (revisioned, replaceable, never persisted or undoable). Every operation carries operation id, base document revision, input generation, preview sequence and deterministic seed. Superseded generations are cancelled and their previews discarded; a commit is accepted only when base revision and generation still match, otherwise it is explicitly rebased or discarded.
- Actor bridge generalising Payload::JobStep, Suspend, Resume and TurnStatus::CheckpointReady onto the job protocol, running one job step per turn.
- Deterministic replay log format and harness.
- A synthetic long-running, preview-producing, cancellable torture job as the protocol's conformance test.

Design inputs already gathered in the master ticket folder as p2-design-inputs.md: semio-framework-machine's PersistedSnapshot/step round-trip is a strong partial fit but is count-bounded rather than deadline-bounded, with no mid-macrostep yield, no preview channel and no fault channel; the actor layer's TurnStatus/Budget/Usage map cleanly onto StepOutcome/StepContext; Puzzle 3D's FillBuilder session is the working template to generalise; the tracing crate's operation/generation record functions are the instrumentation substrate and should not be duplicated.

Exit gate: the synthetic job stays responsive, previews continuously, observes cancellation within 8 ms at p99, and replays deterministically across worker counts from 1 to N.
